translations.literal: Your subject finds that Yi's deliberations differed from Anshi's, yet on this matter he deeply approved it—showing that principle and human hearts agree and can converge without prior arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Yi differed from Anshi on most matters yet deeply approved this—showing principle and human hearts converge.

sentences.zh: 特以司馬光、韓維之徒皆是大賢，人所敬信，其議偶不出此，而安石 乃以變亂穿鑿得罪於公議，故欲堅守二賢之說，並安石所當取者而盡廢之。

translations.literal: Only because Sima Guang, Han Wei, and others were all great worthies whom people trusted, and their deliberation happened not to take this course, while Anshi was condemned in public opinion for perverse change and forced interpretation, one wishes to adhere to the two worthies' views and abolish even what Anshi rightly held.
translations.idiomatic: Because Guang, Wei, and others were trusted worthies whose view happened not to take this course, while Anshi was condemned for forced interpretation, one wishes to adhere to the worthies and abolish even what Anshi rightly held.

sentences.zh: 今以程頤之說考之，則是非可判矣。」

translations.literal: Examined by Cheng Yi's view, right and wrong can be judged."
translations.idiomatic: Examined by Cheng Yi's view, right and wrong can be judged."

sentences.zh: 時宰臣趙汝愚既以安石之論為非，異議者懼其軋己，藉以求勝，事竟不行。

translations.literal: Chief Councilor Zhao Ruyu already held Anshi's theory wrong; those of differing views, fearing he would overpower them, seized on this to seek victory, and in the end the matter was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councilor Zhao Ruyu already held Anshi's theory wrong; dissenters, fearing overpowering, seized on this to win, and the matter failed.

sentences.zh: 熹時以得罪，遺汝愚書曰：「相公以宗子入輔王室，而無故輕納妄議，拆祖宗之廟以快 其私，欲望神靈降歆，垂休錫羨，以永國祚於無窮，其可得乎？」

translations.literal: Xi, then under censure, sent Ruyu a letter saying: "The chief minister entered as an imperial clansman to assist the royal house, yet without cause lightly accepted reckless deliberation, dismantling the temples of the ancestors to gratify private desire—can one expect the spirits to descend, bestow blessing, and extend the nation's fortune forever?"
translations.idiomatic: Xi, then under censure, wrote Ruyu: "You entered as an imperial clansman to assist the throne, yet lightly accepted reckless deliberation, dismantling ancestral temples for private ends—can spirits descend and extend the nation's fortune forever?"

sentences.zh: 時太廟殿已為十二室，故孝宗升祔，而東室尚虛。

translations.literal: At that time the Imperial Ancestral Temple hall already had twelve shrines; therefore when Xiaozong was installed, the eastern shrine was still vacant.
translations.idiomatic: The temple hall already had twelve shrines; when Xiaozong was installed, the eastern shrine remained vacant.

sentences.zh: 熹以為非所以祝延壽康之意，深不然之，因自劾 不堪言語侍從之選，乞追奪待制，不許。

translations.literal: Xi held that this was not conducive to prayers for longevity and health, deeply disapproved, and therefore memorialized himself requesting removal from attendance on the emperor—asking that his academician title be revoked; this was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Xi held this not conducive to prayers for longevity, deeply disapproved, and requested removal from attendance—asking revocation of his academician title; this was refused.

sentences.zh: 及光宗祔廟，遂復為九世十二室。

translations.literal: When Guangzong's tablet was installed, it again became nine generations and twelve shrines.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong's tablet was installed, it again became nine generations and twelve shrines.

sentences.zh: 蓋自昌陵祔廟，逾二百年而後正太祖之位。

translations.literal: In general, from the installation at Changling until the rectification of Taizu's seat, more than two hundred years passed.
translations.idiomatic: In all, more than two hundred years passed from installation at Changling until Taizu's seat was finally rectified.

sentences.zh: 慶元二年四月，禮部太常寺言：「已於太廟之 西，別建僖祖廟，及告遷僖、順、翼、宣帝後神主詣僖祖廟奉安。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Qingyuan, the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "A separate temple for Emperor Xi has already been built west of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the spirit tablets of Emperors Xi, Shun, Yi, and Xuan have been escorted to the temple of Emperor Xi for installation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Qingyuan, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "A separate temple for Emperor Xi has been built west of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and the tablets of Emperors Xi, Shun, Yi, and Xuan have been escorted there for installation.

sentences.zh: 所有今年孟冬祫享，先詣四祖廟室行禮，次詣太廟，逐幄次行禮。」

translations.literal: For this year's first-month-of-winter xiá offering, rites shall first be performed at the four ancestral temple shrines, then at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, with rites performed in sequence at each enclosure."
translations.idiomatic: For this year's winter xiá offering, rites shall first be performed at the four ancestral shrines, then at the Imperial Ancestral Temple in sequence at each enclosure."

sentences.zh: 理宗紹定四年九 月丙戌，京師大火，延及太廟。

translations.literal: On the ninth day of the ninth month, bingxu, of the fourth year of Shaoding under Emperor Lizong, a great fire broke out in the capital and spread to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day of the ninth month, bingxu, of the fourth year of Shaoding, a great fire broke out in the capital and spread to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿度正言：「伏見近世大儒侍講朱熹詳考古禮，尚論宗廟之制，畫而為圖，其說甚備。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Du Zheng stated: "I have seen that the great Ru scholar and Lecturer Zhu Xi of recent times examined ancient ritual in detail, discussed the institution of the ancestral temple, drew it as a diagram, and his exposition was very complete.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Du Zheng stated: "The great Ru scholar Zhu Xi, lecturer of recent times, examined ancient ritual in detail, discussed ancestral temple institutions, illustrated them in diagrams, and his exposition was very complete.

sentences.zh: 然其為製，務效於古而頗更本朝之制， 故學士大夫皆有異論，遂不能行。

translations.literal: Yet his design strove to follow antiquity and rather altered our dynasty's institutions; therefore scholar-officials all had differing views, and in the end it could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Yet his design strove to follow antiquity and altered our dynasty's institutions; scholar-officials differed, and it could not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 今天降災異，火發民家，延及宗廟，舉而行之，莫此時為宜。

translations.literal: Now Heaven sends this calamity: fire arose among the people and spread to the ancestral temple—there is no better time to implement it.
translations.idiomatic: Now Heaven sends this calamity—fire among the people spread to the ancestral temple—and there is no better time to implement it.

sentences.zh: 臣於向來備聞其說，今備員禮寺，適當此變，若遂隱默，則為有負， 謹為二說以獻。

translations.literal: Your subject has long heard his theory in full; now serving in the ritual office at just this crisis, to remain silent would be a failure of duty. I respectfully offer two proposals for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: Having long heard his theory and now serving in the ritual office at this crisis, silence would be failure of duty; I respectfully offer two proposals.

sentences.zh: 其一，純用朱熹之說，謂本朝廟製未合於古，因畫為圖，謂僖祖如周後稷，當為本朝始祖。

translations.literal: The first wholly adopts Zhu Xi's theory, holding that our dynasty's temple design does not accord with antiquity; drawing a diagram, he holds that Emperor Xi, like Hou Ji of Zhou, should be our dynasty's founding ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: The first wholly adopts Zhu Xi's theory, holding our temple design uncanonical; in his diagram Emperor Xi, like Zhou's Hou Ji, should be founding ancestor.

sentences.zh: 夫尊僖祖以為始祖，是乃順太祖皇帝之孝心也。

translations.literal: To honor Emperor Xi as founding ancestor is to follow the filial heart of Emperor Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring Emperor Xi as founding ancestor follows Taizu's filial intent.

sentences.zh: 始祖之廟 居於中，左昭右穆各為一廟，門皆南向，位皆東向。

translations.literal: The founding ancestor's temple stands in the center; zhao left and mu right each form one temple, all gates facing south and all seats facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The founding ancestor's temple stands at the center; zhao left and mu right each form a temple, gates south and seats east.

sentences.zh: 祧廟之主藏於始祖之廟夾室，昭常為昭，穆常為穆，自不相亂。

translations.literal: Tablets of removed-branch temples are stored in the side chambers of the founding ancestor's temple; zhao remains zhao and mu remains mu, never confused.
translations.idiomatic: Removed-branch tablets are stored in the founding ancestor's side chambers; zhao remains zhao and mu mu, never confused.

sentences.zh: 三年合食，則並出祧廟之主，合享於始祖之廟。

translations.literal: Once every three years at the combined feast, tablets from removed-branch temples are all brought out and share the feast at the founding ancestor's temple.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years at the combined feast, removed-branch tablets are brought out to share the feast at the founding ancestor's temple.

sentences.zh: 始祖東向，群昭之主皆位北而南向，群穆之主皆位南而北向。

translations.literal: The founding ancestor faces east; all zhao lords are placed to the north facing south, and all mu lords to the south facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The founding ancestor faces east; all zhao to the north facing south, all mu to the south facing north.

sentences.zh: 昭穆既分，尊卑以定。

translations.literal: With zhao and mu divided, superior and inferior are fixed.
translations.idiomatic: With zhao and mu divided, rank is fixed.

sentences.zh: 其說合於古而宜於今，盡美盡善。

translations.literal: This theory accords with antiquity and suits the present—utterly beautiful and good.
translations.idiomatic: This accords with antiquity and suits the present—utterly complete.

sentences.zh: 舉而行之，祖宗在天之靈必歆享於此，而垂祐 於無窮也。

translations.literal: If carried out, the ancestors' spirits in Heaven will surely rejoice here and bestow blessing without end.
translations.idiomatic: If carried out, the ancestors in Heaven will rejoice and bestow endless blessing.

sentences.zh: 其一說，則因本朝之制，而參以朱熹之說。

translations.literal: The second proposal follows our dynasty's institutions while incorporating Zhu Xi's theory.
translations.idiomatic: The second follows our institutions while incorporating Zhu Xi's theory.

sentences.zh: 蓋本朝廟製，神宗嘗命禮官陸佃討論，欲復古制，未及施行。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's temple design—Emperor Shenzong once ordered ritual officials led by Lu Dian to deliberate, wishing to restore ancient institutions, but it was not implemented in time.
translations.idiomatic: Our temple design—Shenzong once ordered Lu Dian and ritual officials to deliberate on restoring antiquity, but it was not implemented in time.

sentences.zh: 渡江以來，稽古禮文之事，多所未暇。

translations.literal: Since crossing south, matters of examining ancient ritual have mostly been left undone.
translations.idiomatic: Since crossing south, examination of ancient ritual has mostly been left undone.

sentences.zh: 今欲驟行 更革，恐未足以成其事，而徒為紛紛。

translations.literal: Now to attempt sudden reform may not suffice to accomplish the matter and would only create turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Sudden reform may not accomplish the matter and would only create turmoil.

sentences.zh: 或且仍遵本朝之制，自西徂東，並為一列。

translations.literal: Perhaps for the present our dynasty's institutions may still be followed, from west to east arranged in one row.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps our institutions may still be followed, arranged in one row from west to east.

sentences.zh: 惟於每室之後，量展一間，以藏祧廟之主。

translations.literal: Only behind each shrine, extend one bay to store tablets of removed-branch temples.
translations.idiomatic: Only behind each shrine, extend one bay to store removed-branch tablets.

sentences.zh: 每室之前，量展二間，遇三年袷享，則 以帷幄幕之，通為一室，盡出諸廟主及祧廟主並為一列，合食其上。

translations.literal: Before each shrine, extend two bays; when the three-year xiá is performed, enclose them with curtains and screens into one hall, bring out all shrine tablets and removed-branch tablets in one row, and share the feast above.
translations.idiomatic: Before each shrine extend two bays; at the three-year xiá, enclose with curtains into one hall, bring out all shrine and removed-branch tablets in one row, and feast together.

sentences.zh: 前乎此廟為一室，凡遇袷享，合祭於其室，名為袷享，而實未嘗合。

translations.literal: Before this, the temples were one hall; whenever xiá was performed, sacrifice was in that hall by name called xiá, yet in fact there was never true combination.
translations.idiomatic: Before this the temples formed one hall; xiá was performed there in name, yet never truly combined.

sentences.zh: 今量展此三間，後有藏祧主 之所，前有祖宗合食之地，於本朝之制，初無大段更革，而頗已得三年大袷之義。

translations.literal: Now extending these three bays—behind, a place to store removed-branch tablets; before, a place for ancestors to feast together—our institutions need no great change yet largely obtain the meaning of the three-year great xiá.
translations.idiomatic: Extending these three bays—storage behind, combined feasting before—requires no great change yet largely obtains the three-year great xiá.

sentences.zh: 今來朝廷若能舉行朱熹前議，固無以加；

translations.literal: If the court can now implement Zhu Xi's former proposal, nothing could be better;
translations.idiomatic: If the court can implement Zhu Xi's former proposal, nothing could be better;

sentences.zh: 如其不然，姑從後說，亦為允當，不失禮 意。

translations.literal: if not, then for the present following the latter proposal is also acceptable and does not depart from ritual intent.
translations.idiomatic: if not, the latter proposal is also acceptable and does not depart from ritual intent.

sentences.zh: 然宗廟之禮，倘無其故，何敢妄議？

translations.literal: Yet in ancestral temple rites, without proper cause, who would dare deliberate rashly?
translations.idiomatic: Yet in ancestral temple rites, without proper cause who would dare deliberate rashly?

sentences.zh: 今因大火之後，若加損益，亦惟其時，乞賜詳議。」

translations.literal: Now after the great fire, to add or reduce is timely; we beg detailed deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: Now after the great fire, revision is timely; we beg detailed deliberation.

sentences.zh: 有旨，令侍從、禮部、太常集議，後竟不行。

translations.literal: An order directed the attendants, Ministry of Rites, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices to assemble for deliberation; in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: An order directed attendants, the Ministry of Rites, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices to deliberate; in the end it was not carried out.
